parameters.name: Tasks
parameters.description: The array of image URLs to be detected.

sub_parameters.name: ImageURL
sub_parameters.description:
The URL of the image to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is an image detection task structure (image table). A maximum of 10 elements are supported, meaning up to 10 images can be detected simultaneously. We recommend using OSS links in the Shanghai region. For local files or OSS links in regions other than Shanghai, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

> The system automatically converts OSS link addresses to internal network addresses before downloading files, so calling this API does not incur OSS traffic charges.
